title: 第804章 以后谁吹牛能吹的过我们？
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条

第(1/3)页

李应灵看了两眼自己的人偶，随后询问道：

“我好像师父有说过这东西，似真非真才让人觉得可爱，之前倒觉得师父在胡扯，现在看看，或许师父说的是有些道理。”

厉行天摸向了人偶，观摩了半天或许是觉得自己微抿的嘴唇看起来有点凶样，便伸手摸了摸似乎想将紧抿的嘴唇弄点笑意出来。

“大师姐喜欢便好。”陈白青适时的又给李应灵添了杯茶。

李应灵目光好奇的望向了袋子：“应该也有师父的吧？什么模样？”

话音才落，李应灵摇了摇头道：“算了，回头等大家起了看更有些意思。”

有新鲜感吐槽的时候才会更舒服。

例如当着崔浩的面说他的人偶丑，一点儿也不帅气。

或者说师父的人偶太装了。

提前看了再吐槽就显得多少有些刻意了。

李应灵满意的捧起了人偶，随后将其收到空间戒指之中。

至于钱清一事，她的选择是先给缘空送份玉令去，问他如何处置，同时也会将消息同步给师父。

毕竟这件事真论起来也和她并无什么太大关系，

这段时间养个武夫，吃的也是天衍宗的粮，又不花自己家灵石。

李应灵目光最终又放在了陈白青身上。

不管怎样去讲，这都是自家师妹，真要气那也就只是一时的罢了。

更何况师妹想法和做法不对，自己身为大师姐自然也有责任，将来再细心教导一番，这责任李应灵也是认的。

李应灵将人偶收回空间戒指之中，语气轻松不少道：

“这事可还没没翻篇，小白青你可是犯了宗门管理条例，回头有空了责罚可一点也少不了，十全大补丸的滋味你可也得好好尝尝了。”

陈白青闻言目光稍有些疑惑的望向了李应灵：

“宗门管理条例？这我好像没有犯吧？”

李应灵语气自然且笃定：“自然有，宗门条例我和师父一直在调整补充修改，你定然没有仔细去了解。”

陈白青微微回忆，随后回应道：

Li Yingling glanced at his puppet and then asked:

"I think Master once said this. People find it cute when it seems true but not true. I thought Master was talking nonsense before. Now look at it, maybe what Master said makes sense."

Li Xingtian touched the doll, and after observing it for a long time, he felt that his slightly pursed lips looked a bit sinister, so he reached out and touched them as if to make his pursed lips smile.

"As long as Senior Sister likes it." Chen Baiqing gave Li Yingling another cup of tea at the right time.

Li Yingling looked at the bag curiously: "There should be a master there too, right? What does it look like?"

After finishing his words, Li Yingling shook his head and said, "Forget it, it will be more interesting to watch it later when everyone gets up."

You will feel more comfortable when you have something fresh to complain about.

For example, he said in front of Cui Hao that his doll was ugly and not handsome at all.

In other words, Master’s puppet is too pretentious.

After watching it in advance and then complaining, it seems somewhat deliberate.

Li Yingling held up the doll with satisfaction and then put it into the space ring.

As for Qian Qing, her choice was to send a jade order to Yuankong first and ask him how to deal with it. At the same time, she would also synchronize the news to the master.

After all, this matter actually has nothing to do with her.

During this period of time, raising a martial artist will only require food from the Tianyan Sect, and it won't cost any spiritual stones from one's own family.

Li Yingling's eyes finally focused on Chen Baiqing.

No matter how you put it, this is my junior sister. If you are really angry, it will only be temporary.

What's more, if the junior sister's ideas and actions are wrong, as a senior sister, she naturally has a responsibility. If she teaches her carefully in the future, Li Yingling will also recognize this responsibility.

Li Yingling put the puppet back into the space ring and said in a relaxed tone:

"This matter hasn't ended yet. Xiao Baiqing, you have violated the sect's management regulations. You will definitely be punished when you have time later. You have to taste the taste of Shiquan Dabu Pill."

When Chen Baiqing heard this, he looked at Li Yingling with a little doubt:

"Sect management regulations? I don't seem to have violated this, right?"

Li Yingling's tone was natural and determined: "Of course there is. Master and I have been adjusting and revising the sect's regulations. You must not have understood it carefully."
